title: JSON schema for LAMMPS fix symmetry data files

group_name.description: Optional descriptive name of the space group (e.g. 'P-1', 'Pm', 'Fm-3m'). Not interpreted by the fix.

lattice.description: Bravais lattice family the simulation box must satisfy.

ops.description: List of affine operators (R, t) acting on fractional coordinates: s' = R*s + t. The first entry must be the identity {R = I, t = 0}.

t.description: Length-3 fractional translation. Each component may be a number (e.g. 0.5) or a rational string (e.g. "1/2").

orbits.description: List of symmetry orbits. Each orbit's 'tags' array is parallel to 'ops': tags[0] is the asymmetric representative; tags[k>=1] is the atom related to it by ops[k]. For atoms on Wyckoff special positions, repeat the asym tag in tags[k] for every k in the stabilizer and list those op indices (1-based, excluding op 1) in site_symmetry.

tags.description: Atom tags forming this orbit; length must equal the number of operators.

site_symmetry.description: 1-based op indices (excluding 1) that fix the asymmetric atom. Optional. For each declared k, tags[k] must equal tags[0].
